title: 동일 제출 그룹의 불변 signal 순서 재검사 재사용
existingWork: validGroupSignals는 제출 준비와 publication에서 호출되며 이전 signal pair를 다시 순회.
missingEvidence: zero/one signal에서는 절약이 작고 proof 전달 비용이 더 클 수 있음.
requiredBoundary: 같은 그룹의 상대 순서 proof만 재사용; 현재 event 값은 publication 때 다시 확인. 첫 검사 없는 직접 호출자는 full validation.

risk.function: 중간: direct publication은 full validation이 기본이어야 함. 이전 성공 proof 없는 호출자에서 생략하면 거부조건 약화.
risk.lifetime: 낮음~중간: proof는 같은 group/같은 children/signals에만 귀속. raw event 주소 global cache 금지.
risk.synchronization: 중간: 첫 검사 후 외부 event signaledValue 증가를 publication에서 다시 거부해야 함.
risk.memory: 작은 bool/token 가능하지만 one-signal common path에는 branch/plumbing만 늘 수 있음.

strategy: A noncopyable submit-local proof names the exact fresh strongly-held group after its successful complete check. Ended claimed children reject legal event mutation. Publication still reads current event values; direct calls and absent/mismatched proof run full validation.
acceptance: Repeated multi-signal groups established; zero/one-signal paths not burdened with new allocation
Token cannot outlive or cross changed children/signal lists
Concurrent external event advancement remains rejected at publication
tests: Existing group signal/timeline cases: unsorted/duplicate, zero/one/multi, direct publication and retry
Current value advances after validation; wrong-group proof falls back, legal Ended mutation is rejected. Arbitrary private-vector mutation is outside the proven invariant.
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
